class_defs.ACTIVE: Valid registration with onchain activity (USDC, reputation, or validation), outside mass clusters.
class_defs.BACKGROUND: Valid registration, no further activity observed yet.
class_defs.INCOMPLETE: Registration file invalid or not yet verified.
class_defs.STANDOUT: Valid registration and a live endpoint, outside any mass-registration cluster.

ENDPOINT_BLOCKED.explanation: Primary endpoint was not fetched: it points at a non-public address or disallowed URL.

ENDPOINT_HTTP_ERROR.explanation: Probed endpoint answered with an HTTP error (e.g. 404/410/5xx).

ENDPOINT_LIVE.explanation: Probed endpoint answered HTTP 2xx/3xx, or 400/401/402/403/405/406/422/429 (server up; request needed parameters, auth or payment).

ENDPOINT_UNREACHABLE.explanation: Primary endpoint could not be reached (DNS/connect/TLS/timeout).

HIGH_REGISTRATION_DENSITY.explanation: Owner registered >= 10 agents within ~1h (7200 blocks) ending at this registration.

HTTP_402_OBSERVED.explanation: Primary endpoint answered HTTP 402 Payment Required.

MASS_REGISTRATION_CLUSTER.explanation: Owner address controls >= 20 agents. Common for platforms and batch deployers; not a judgement.

METADATA_INVALID.explanation: Registration file is missing, malformed, or fails a blocking ERC-8004 check.

METADATA_UNVERIFIED.explanation: Registration file not verified yet (pending fetch, IPFS, or unsupported scheme).

METADATA_VALID.explanation: Registration file decodes and passes the ERC-8004 registration-v1 checks.

NEW_AGENT.explanation: Registered in the IdentityRegistry within the last ~24h (172,800 blocks) of this snapshot.

REPUTATION_FEEDBACK_PRESENT.explanation: At least one NewFeedback event targets this agent in the ReputationRegistry.

USDC_ACTIVITY_PRESENT.explanation: Owner address sent or received USDC in the rolling ~6h window (gas payments excluded).

VALIDATION_ACTIVITY_PRESENT.explanation: At least one ValidationRequest/Response targets this agent.

X402_DECLARED.explanation: Registration file declares x402Support: true (a declaration, not a payment test).
